why: PI-20261027-KYYBSZXS-0001. place_protective cancels the position's own resting protective legs, then POSTs the OCO; a refusal left the position with no bracket until the next sweep. MEASURED 2026-11-16 14:32:55-14:35:03Z on alpaca_paper: seven refusals ('insufficient qty available for order (requested: 9375, available: 0)'), none on alpaca_live/alpaca_portfolio in the retained journal (~24 h). 'Place first' cannot work on Alpaca (the resting legs reserve the shares), so after a refusal the cancelled own legs are re-placed at their OLD prices, always GTC (one OCO, or a plain stop, or a plain limit), and a released sibling target is re-placed when the retry is also refused. The returned retCode still reads refused (the sweep retries as before) and carries 'restored' + a retMsg suffix; a failed restore is reported, never raised, never invented.
